This is me

Hi! This is S.G.Kethaki Nishadi, and I'm someone who's always been passionate about creativity, technology and everything in between.

My interest in the creative industry started when I was just 13, when I first discovered digital marketing, branding and creative design.
 What began as a hobby gradually grew into a passion that I've continued to explore and develop over the years.

Most of what I know today comes from self-learning, online courses, experimenting with different tools and gaining hands-on experience. I've always loved exploring how creativity, technology, branding and business come together to turn ideas into something meaningful.

Served as Head of Committee of School Entrepreneurship Club.

School Prefect. Chairperson of School Interact Club.

Participated in a major entrepreneurial event launched by APIIT University, THE SANDBOX, Led and represented the team during competition and presentations.Secured a position in the Top 10 out of 60+ major schools at the competition. This competition led me to UI/UX designs.
